meta.title: SSO Authentication: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Verify that SSO Authentication is absent or refused on a Growth-plan tenant.
Verify that the same Tenant Admin can use SSO Authentication on an Enterprise-plan tenant.
Compare SSO availability across Growth and Enterprise tenants while holding the user role and steps constant.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that SSO Authentication is absent or refused on a Growth-plan tenant.; Verify that the same Tenant Admin can use SSO Authentication on an Enterprise-plan tenant.; Compare SSO availability across Growth and Enterprise tenants while holding the user role and steps constant.

args.need: sign in as the same Tenant Admin on the Growth-plan tenant and the Enterprise-plan tenant, attempt SSO Authentication on each, and record that Growth is unavailable while Enterprise works

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch to unspecified plan-tier tenants or observe the SSO authentication capability.
Confirm the session remains usable and shows no unrelated application error after the tester's verification.
